audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read 'Garen' in both layers while whys[0] on the same page says your autos push him off farm and he has no gap-close — a direct self-contradiction the mirror also flagged. Levels 2-3 read 'Skill' though both this page and the mirror give the early game to Renekton, and Levels 4-5, Level 6 and First item read 'Skill' though whys[3], whys[4] and whys[5] all describe Garen taking over.
audit.why: 48.64% over 4159 games with a front-loaded Renekton curve. Packet chart and mirror (garen__renekton) agree: Renekton 1-3, Garen from 4 onward.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Renekton, rows 3-5 to Garen, row 6 already Garen. Proposed as one atomic group with matched full/content pairs; ratings set to the inverse of the mirror's (6/6/6 then 4/4/4).

audit.whatIsWrong: The First-item row credited your Eclipse; the item that decides that window is Garen's Stridebreaker.
audit.why: spikes[2] on this page already states Stridebreaker lets him close, silence the cast and all-in through your Q heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly tells you to wait for Courage to expire before committing. That is backwards: at 50+ Fury your W destroys damage shields on the target, so the empowered W is the answer to Courage, not something to hold until it ends. Courage also grants tenacity, which shortens your stun — never stated.
audit.why: Renekton W: 'destroying damage shields on the target ... stunning them for 1.5 seconds' at 50+ Fury. Garen W: 'a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction'. Its cooldown is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12, not the 24s the page claims.
audit.corrected: Shield destruction and the tenacity effect stated in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d and wants.you[1]; the 24s figure corrected to 22s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Courage's cooldown was written as 24 seconds.
audit.why: Riot's value is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12 — the number the player times a commit on.
audit.corrected: Corrected in the 'early' block and stated in report[5].t.

edits.before: Fury autos bully the first waves. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Fury autos bully wave one — Garen has no gap-close until Decisive Strike, so chip him off the melee minions.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Courage's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker beats your Eclipse — he closes, silences your cast, spins through the heal.

edits.before: Damage reduction on cast. Burst once it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shield plus tenacity on cast — at 50+ Fury your W destroys the shield, so commit empowered.

edits.before: Track Garen's Courage: Damage reduction on cast. Burst once it’s down. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Courage shields and gives tenacity, 22s at rank 1 — empowered W destroys the shield, the plain one gets shrugged.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: W gives tenacity too, cutting your stun — open at 50 Fury to break it.

edits.before: Bank 50 Fury on the wave, slice onto him the moment Courage expires, land empowered W stun, Q heal through his counter-swing, and dice back out
edits.after: Bank 50 Fury before you slice in — the empowered W destroys Courage's shield and stuns 1.5s, then Q heal through his spin and dice back out

edits.before: At level 1 you actually edge this — auto-harass to push Garen off farm and set up the wave before you have your full kit. He wants to walk up, Q-silence you before you can stun, and trade short. Deny him that by staying just outside his Q range and using autos to chip. Hit level 2 first if you can and immediately slice in: Garen's Courage has a 24-second cooldown and if he pops it on your opening auto you should still have enough Fury to land the empowered W stun plus Q heal and dash back out ahead. Level 3 is genuinely even — his full kit is online too, and his W plus passive tankiness means all-ins without Fury preparation will end in your favor only on the stats; never trade at zero Fury.
edits.after: At level 1 you actually edge this — auto-harass to push Garen off farm and set up the wave before you have your full kit. He wants to walk up, Q-silence you before you can stun, and trade short. Deny him that by staying just outside his 300-range Q and using autos to chip. Hit level 2 first if you can and immediately slice in: Courage runs 22s at rank 1, and if he pops it on your opening auto your empowered W destroys the shield anyway, so land the 1.5s stun plus Q heal and dash back out ahead. Level 3 stays yours on Fury discipline — his W tenacity shortens a zero-Fury stun into nothing; never trade at zero Fury.

notes: The single highest-value fix here matches the mirror: the page was telling the player to wait out Courage when empowered Ruthless Predator destroys the shield outright. Level chart proposed as one atomic group across both layers; row 6 (2+ items) already read Garen and was left alone. diff reads 'HARD' while report[14].t calls it 'Even matchup' and diffRating is 6/10 — the mirror set the Garen side at 5/10 difficulty in his favour, so these three lines disagree with each other; I left the wording rather than guess a tone hex.
